_readme: Partner links that are not transfer services: flights home, travel eSIMs, and sponsors on the house calculator.

travel.flightsUrl: the flight search each 'Search flights' button opens. Placeholders: {from} and {to} (airport or city codes, e.g. LON, NBO), {fromCity} and {toCity} (names), {route} (e.g. fly-kenya).
travel.flightsWrap: once Travelpayouts (or another network) approves you, paste its tracked link here with the destination replaced by {url}. Leave empty for a plain, untracked link.
travel.esimUrl / travel.esimWrap: the same for the eSIM button. {country} is the country name.

sponsors: paid listings on the house-calculator pages. Each needs id (lowercase, no spaces), name, category, blurb, url (https), countries (ids from data/build-costs.json), starts and ends (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: phone, badge. A sponsor shows only between starts and ends, always labelled Sponsored, and never changes the receipt.
origins: departure cities per sending region. airports: arrival airports per receiving country. Codes are IATA city or airport codes.
